title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E1 — Problem
DeSoto is forced to give medical treatment without authorization when the radio link to the hospital is broken; guest Lloyd Bochner.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E2 — Kids
Brackett insists an injured boy is a child-abuse victim; the paramedics aid a trapped boy and a fallen hiker; guest Richard Jaeckel.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E3 — Show Biz
Gage is selected to be the model for an ideal firefighter; Brackett urges an aging doctor who has suffered a heart attack to retire.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E4 — Virus
A mysterious virus strikes Brackett, Gage and a firefighter; the paramedics aid a teenage vertigo victim; guest Cathy Lee Crosby.

title: The A-Team
description:
S5 E3 — Firing Line
Murdock and Frankie Santana ask Gen. Stockwell to help them rescue B.A., Hannibal and Face from a military firing squad.

title: The A-Team
description:
S5 E4 — Quarterback Sneak
The team joins a touring pro football squad to free an East German scientist; guests Alan Autry, Jim Brown, John Matuszak, Joe Namath.

title: The A-Team
description:
S5 E5 — The Theory of Revolution
The team must free three CIA agents from a Caribbean prison before an ambitious dictator strikes a deal with the Soviet military.

title: The A-Team
description:
S5 E6 — The Say Uncle Affair
Stockwell orders the team to steal a Soviet stealth fighter-jet, then is kidnapped by a free-lance spy (David McCallum).

title: The A-Team
description:
S5 E7 — Alive at Five
The team infiltrates an East Coast mob to free an undercover TV reporter from her kingpin lover.

title: The A-Team
description:
S1 E2 — The Children of Jamestown
The rest of the team is caught while Murdock flies a girl to freedom from a religious paramilitary cult; guest John Saxon.

title: The A-Team
description:
S1 E3 — Pros and Cons
A boy (Meeno Peluce) whose brother (William Smith) has been unlawfully imprisoned asks his friend B.A. for help; guest Ken Norton.

title: The A-Team
description:
S1 E4 — A Small and Deadly War
The team investigates when a SWAT officer suspects his squad of crimes; guests Jack Ging, Dean Stockwell.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E5 — Rainbow's End
David searches for a trainer who has achieved remarkable success calming a troublesome race horse with a vitamin formula.
